name: Counselors in Training (Santa Barbara Museum of Natural History)
org: Santa Barbara Museum of Natural History
what_you_do: You help run Nature Adventures summer camps for young children. The camps are at the Museum and Sea Center. You do crafts, exhibit visits and activities. You earn community service hours. You also learn to teach.
who_can_apply: Teens ages 13 to 17. Uniform shirt required: $20 (waived for teens with SNAP/Cal Fresh EBT).
pay_detail: Unpaid. Community service hours. $20 uniform shirt (waived with SNAP/CalFresh EBT).
duration: At least 3 full weeks of camp (2026 camps ran June 15 to Aug 14)
deadline_text: 2026 cycle: applications opened April 1 and were due April 30, 2026. CIT training was June 12, 2026. Next cycle dates are not posted.
how_to_apply: Fill in the online CIT application form. Contact Haylee Rosso at hrosso@sbnature2.org or 805-682-4711 ext. 170.
notes: Dates shown are the 2026 cycle. The page says summer CITs are invited back for fall, winter and spring break camps.
